## Implemented authority

B9.1 introduces durable `PresentationRevision` state without mutating Career Evidence.

```text
CareerEvidence revision
        ↓ exact owner/revision/hash binding
PresentationRevision PROPOSED
        ↓ explicit user decision only
APPROVED | REJECTED
```

## Quarry findings captured during closure

### Q-B9.1-001 — PostgreSQL default EXECUTE surface

The first B9.1 candidate failed B8 with:

```text
B8_ANON_EXECUTE_SURFACE_REMAINS:1
```

Cause: PostgreSQL grants `EXECUTE` on newly created functions to `PUBLIC` by default. The internal trigger helper `cv_engine_guard_presentation_revision_update()` therefore expanded the anonymous callable surface.

Resolution: forward migration explicitly revokes execution from `PUBLIC`, `anon` and `authenticated`.

### Q-B9.1-002 — Account export schema regression

The next candidate failed B8 with:

```text
B8_EXPORT_VERSION_MISMATCH
```

Cause: B9 initially changed the account export envelope from `b8-account-export-v1` to `b9-account-export-v1` merely to add `presentationRevisions`.

Resolution: preserve the B8 schema version and extend the payload additively. B9 tests now require both backward-compatible envelope identity and the B9 collection.

These failures are retained as evidence that inherited gates remained authoritative rather than being relaxed to admit B9.
